describes: packages/plugin/signature: reads, hydration and validation, document events, fills, the sign-here target, one-shot and two-phase signing, the destination rule and the armed mark.

cases.name: reads-over-the-snapshot
cases.covers: The initial read lands the snapshot and, since something is signed, a validation of the working copy. The lists are memoized per snapshot. getSignature finds a field by ref (sameRef, which a mixed pair never matches), by name, by a widget's object number or annotation ref (a widget the snapshot doesn't carry is looked up through the form plugin), and answers null for an unknown address or an address that is neither. getVerdict follows the last validation.

cases.name: signed-by-truthiness
cases.covers: The lists split on the truthiness of `signed`, whatever its type: null, 0 and '' are unsigned; 1, 'x', {} and [] are signed.
cases.reason: Pins authority twins, revision reads, placement by mode and the armed-mark handler, through call outcomes, settlements and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: get-signature-edges
cases.covers: A widget the snapshot carries but the form plugin doesn't know is found by the snapshot alone. An objectNumber address with neither a widget nor a field object number is not a field ref, so it answers null even against a signature whose field ref lacks the number too.

cases.name: nothing-signed-reads
cases.covers: A snapshot with nothing signed lands without a validation, so getVerdict answers null from no verdicts at all.

cases.name: signature-service-refuses-unsupported
cases.covers: Without the engine's signatures service the snapshot is null and stays idle: reads answer empty, refresh and validate answer null and [], analyzeChanges and readRevision refuse unsupported (readRevision synchronously), and every signing verb rejects unsupported. abortPending with nothing parked resolves.

cases.name: authority-twins

cases.reason: Pins authority twins, revision reads, placement by mode and the armed-mark handler, through call outcomes, settlements and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: the-initial-read-fails

cases.name: refresh-status-and-protection
cases.covers: The first read is loading until it lands, then ready. A protection that differs from the last snapshot's announces itself, one that is the same doesn't; a listener that throws is reported. A later read keeps the status ready while it runs.

cases.name: validate-and-the-invalidation-edge
cases.covers: validate judges the working copy by default and records the verdicts. A verdict that turns invalid because of unsaved edits warns once, on the edge (its detail, or '' without one); staying invalid doesn't warn again, and neither does a persisted basis. `at` and `until` pass through; validateField answers one field's verdict or rejects not-found.

cases.name: document-events
cases.covers: A parked, aborted or completed signing sets and clears the pending signing. A new version or a desync re-reads and re-judges; a change of the field set re-reads and re-judges soon; an edit of the working copy re-judges soon, coalesced into one validation 300 ms after the last edit. Other events are ignored.

cases.covers: fillField draws the mark's bytes into the field, re-reads the form, clears the field as the sign-here target and announces the fill, busy while it runs. clearField draws the blank page. A signed field refuses conflict; an unknown asset mark refuses not-found without the stamp plugin.

cases.name: the-sign-here-target
cases.covers: setTarget announces a new target; the same ref again, or null again, is no change; a name and an object number never match each other, two names match by name. A fill of another field keeps the target. requestInspection announces the field.

cases.name: two-phase-signing
cases.covers: prepareSignature parks the signing (pending, with the appearance when a mark or appearance is given) and hands out the digest. completeSignature of a signing this session did not prepare rejects not-found; of the parked one it completes against the prepared version, clears the pending signing and the target, re-reads, re-judges and announces the signature.

cases.name: sign-one-shot
cases.covers: sign resolves the configured signer, prepares with the mark as the appearance and the caller's attribution, has a CMS signer answer, passes the completion gate and completes; then it clears the target, re-reads, starts a validation and announces the signature.

cases.name: sign-with-a-per-call-signer
cases.covers: A per-call signer wins over the configured one, and a function resolves the signer first. An explicit appearance wins over the mark. A validation after signing that fails is reported.

cases.name: sign-with-a-raw-signer
cases.covers: A raw signer's certificate subject is the default /Name, which the caller's attribution overrides; a signer that fails aborts the signing and rejects. A thunk signer resolves per signing. A raw signer with no certificate names no one.

cases.name: sign-without-a-signer

cases.name: an-armed-mark-over-a-field
cases.covers: With the interaction hub and the stamp plugin, an armed asset from a signatures library pressed over an empty signature field disarms and goes into the field by mode. Over a signed field, or a signature field that carries a value, the press is consumed and nothing happens. Over a text field or without a page the handler declines; annotation hit handling retains priority over placement. Over an empty page area the stamp is placed.
